quotes.quote: We enjoyed both the displays, the interactive options, the short videos and the opportunities to view ourselves in the contexts that defined the life of Roosevelt.
quotes.author: Steve R.

quotes.quote: All should enjoy the remembrance of the life well lived by TR.
quotes.author: Brian B.

quotes.quote: Not your typical Library you have interaction with some of the exhibits.
